summary: Names struck by the clerk, not the count submitted, decide whether a petition stands.
realLife: An Austin council member submitted more names than needed and was still short, because some were not valid.
sources: KUT, Austin council member's petition for a third term rejected: https://www.kut.org/austin/2026-08-25/austin-tx-city-council-paige-ellis-third-term-petition-rejected
inGame: the clerk's check against the voter roll (striking moved, unregistered and duplicate names), petition record
